# Avsnitt 196 - Arma-turbolag!

**Feed**: kvalitetsaktiepodden  
**Published**: 2026-09-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts look back on the Q2 report period, which was strong. Pinpoint data shows sales and earnings beat expectations and there were fewer profit warnings. They also note how far Swedish small caps have lagged OMXS30 this year, blaming fund outflows, but expect small caps to come back over time. Company talk centres on the planned Rejlers–Multiconsult merger (they are sceptical and sold all their Rejlers shares), Novo Nordisk's vague capital markets day targets (they stay out), Warren Buffett stepping down as Berkshire chair, and job-cut news from Svedbergs.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🔴 REJL-B — Rejlers | **SELL** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Hosts sold their entire holding after the Multiconsult merger was announced at a negative premium. They will stay out for about a year.

#### Reasoning

The hosts had owned Rejlers for its long-term tailwinds (grids, nuclear, defence, water) and an expected rise in billing ratio. They see the merger of equals as diluting that upside. Management will spend at least six months on integration, one-off costs are likely, synergies in a consultancy are doubtful, and past Nordic consultancy mergers (Tieto, ÅF–Pöyry) went badly. Norwegian owners may also object to Rejlers' A-shares.

#### Sell Triggers

- merger voted down at the 19 October EGM
- integration of the merged company proves successful after about a year

> *"Och vi sålde faktiskt alla våra aktier efter publiceringen av det här."*

---

### ⛔ MULTI — Multiconsult | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Hosts are sceptical of the merged Multiconsult-Rejlers. They will stay on the sidelines and reassess in about a year.

#### Reasoning

Multiconsult has been hard to forecast, and the hosts are unhappy with its CEO turnover and corporate-speak communication. They think the deal is better for Multiconsult than for Rejlers but still expect integration trouble. They plan to look at the combined company again in about a year.

#### Sell Triggers

- evidence that integration synergies are materialising

> *"Vi kommer försöka få grepp om nya multikonsult, Rejlers, om något år."*

---

### ⛔ NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Hosts sold around 330 and the stock is now about 258. CMD guidance was vague and management admitted forecasting is nearly impossible. They stay on the sidelines.

#### Reasoning

The hosts cannot build forecasts because of pricing pressure, competition from Eli Lilly, patent expiries and new oral drugs. The capital markets day gave fuzzy targets (peer-level growth, a 'broadly stable' margin, 150bn DKK pipeline sales by 2035) and a hot-mic remark suggested management itself cannot forecast.

#### Sell Triggers

- clearer guidance that makes forecasting possible
- the pipeline delivers the promised blockbusters

> *"Vi kan inte lägga prognoser, det kan inte bolaget heller."*

---

### 🟡 BRK-B — Berkshire Hathaway | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Hosts keep a small long-held watch position. They say Berkshire won't be the same once Buffett and Munger are gone.

#### Reasoning

Buffett is stepping down as chair and Greg Abel has full capital allocation authority. The hosts admire Buffett but are unsure about the post-Buffett era, and hint they may do something with the position when that day comes.

#### Sell Triggers

- Buffett fully departs
- Berkshire's culture or capital allocation changes under Abel

> *"Vi har en liten bevakningspost i Berkshire som vi haft länge, men vi får se vad vi gör med den om den dagen kommer."*

---
